question: What is UPI Lite? Answer briefly.

claims.text: UPI Lite is an 'On-Device wallet' functionality designed by NPCI to process small value digital payments in offline or near-offline mode.
It allows users to allocate funds from their bank account to a balance that resides on-device within the UPI App, where only debit is permitted and credits are processed online.
UPI Lite transactions are offered without a UPI PIN but require app authentication (biometric, pattern, etc.) unless disabled by the user.

quotes.quote: volumes. As an efficient strategy to process large-scale small value digital payments and based on the guidelines issued by RBI for enabling mobile devices to support offline payments vide its circular no. CO.DPSS.POLC.No. S1264/ 02-14-003/2021-2022 titled “Framework for facilitating small value digital payments in offline mode” dated 3rd January 2022, NPCI has designed the “UPI Lite – On-Device wallet” (“UPI Lite”) functionality for UPI user (User). In phase 1, UPI Lite will process transactions in near offline mode i.e. debit offline and credit online, and at a later point, UPI Lite will process transactions in complete offline mode i.e. debit and credit both offline. A User of UPI App will have the option to enable UPI Lite i.e. “On-Device wallet” on her/his UPI App. Once enabled, the User can allocate funds from her/his bank account to UPI Lite. Such funds shall reside with the User’s bank in an escrow / pool / designated account and such balance shall reside on-device on the common library (CL) of the User’s UPI App. At present, only debit from UPI Lite balance shall be permitted and all credits to UPI Lite (including refunds, etc.) will be processed online in the User’s bank account maintained in the bank’s core banking system. The upper limit of an UPI Lite payment transaction shall be ₹200/-.The total limit

sources.text: NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 31st August 2023 To All Member-Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Madam/Sir, **Subject: Enhancement in UPI LITE transaction limit to ₹500** UPI LITE has been designed to play a vital role in reducing infrastructure load on the Core Banking System of the banks. This feature has been making the small value transactions faster and highly reliable for transaction value below ₹200. As per the latest circular issued by RBI on 24th August, 2023 vide Circular No: RBI/2023-24/57 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S526/02-14-003/2023-24 with subject ‘Enhancing transaction limits for Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, the upper limit of an offline payment transaction is now increased from ₹200 to ₹500. In view of the above, the per transaction value limit for UPI LITE (Purpose code 44 - Online and 45 - Offline) has now been enhanced to ₹500. The details are as below: | UPI LITE Limit | Previous Limit | New Limit | |---|---|---| | Per Transaction | ₹200 | ₹500 | | Max balance in UPI lite account | ₹2000 | ₹2000 (No change) | The existing UPI pricing shall be applicable for transaction amount ₹201-₹500 for both P2P and P2M transactions. With reference to the above, Member Banks (Payee PSP), Third Party App providers (TPAPs), Merchants and other payment providers are requested to take note of the above enhancement
